mapper.select: SELECT f. flow_id, f. merchant_base_id, f.order_main_id, f.flow_type, f.flow_amount, f.goods_amount, f.balance_after, f.description, f.create_time, -- 订单详情 o.order_no, o.user_nickname, o.order_type, o.order_status, o.pay_amount, o.delivery_fee_amount, o.pay_time, o.complete_time, -- 商品明细 GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(d.goods_name, ' x', d.quantity) SEPARATOR ', ') AS goods_detail FROM merchant_wallet_flow f LEFT JOIN order_main o ON f.order_main_id = o.order_main_id LEFT JOIN order_takeout_detail d ON o.order_main_id = d.order_main_id AND o.order_type = 1 WHERE f.flow_id = #{flowId} AND f.merchant_base_id = #{merchantBaseId} GROUP BY f.flow_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_wallet_flow ( merchant_base_id, order_main_id, withdraw_id, flow_type, flow_amount, goods_amount, balance_after, description, create_time ) VALUES ( #{merchantBaseId}, #{orderMainId}, #{withdrawId}, #{flowType}, #{flowAmount}, #{goodsAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, NOW() )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_wallet_flow ( merchant_base_id, withdraw_id, flow_type, flow_amount, balance_after, description, create_time ) SELECT #{merchantBaseId}, #{withdrawId}, 'WITHDRAW_FREEZE', -#{totalAmount}, balance, CONCAT('提现冻结，提现单号#', #{withdrawId}), NOW() FROM merchant_wallet WHERE merchant_base_id = #{merchantBaseId}

INSERT INTO merchant_wallet_flow ( merchant_base_id, withdraw_id, flow_type, flow_amount, balance_after, description, create_time ) SELECT #{record.merchantBaseId}, #{record.withdrawId}, 'WITHDRAW_SUCCESS', -#{record.withdrawAmount}, balance, CONCAT('提现成功到账(到账金额',#{record.actualAmount},'，手续费: ',#{record.feeAmount},'),单号：', #{record.withdrawId}), NOW() FROM merchant_wallet WHERE merchant_base_id = #{record.merchantBaseId}

INSERT INTO merchant_wallet_flow ( merchant_base_id, withdraw_id, flow_type, flow_amount, balance_after, description, create_time ) SELECT #{record. merchantBaseId}, #{record.withdrawId}, 'WITHDRAW_ROLLBACK', #{record.withdrawAmount}, balance, CONCAT('提现失败退款，提现单号#', #{record.withdrawId}), NOW() FROM merchant_wallet WHERE merchant_base_id = #{record.merchantBaseId}
